name: Shine Foil Card
description: Grid of image cards that tilt in 3D toward the pointer while a holographic foil layer shines through a conic mask that rotates with the cursor position.
contents: Grid of image cards with a holographic overlay on each
Hidden SVG edge-detection filter used by the shine layer
behavior: Active card tilts in 3D following the pointer and eases back on leave
Holographic overlay fades in on hover and is revealed by a conic mask rotated by pointer angle
Grid is one column on mobile and two columns from 768px, pointer events also respond to touch
editableByProps: Number of cards, image sources and alt text
Grid max width and tilt sensitivity

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the shine mask colors or stops
needsCodeEdit.where: conic-gradient maskImage in the overlay div style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card size or corner radius
needsCodeEdit.where: aspect-[9/12] card div and rounded-[1em] figure

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
SVG filter with id filterEdges is injected into the page
